open_points.subject: A18 startup cleanup of unreferenced value bytes
open_points.text: “On start, temporary files, value bytes no record names … are removed”; only an unremovable spool directory is explicitly allowed to remain without stopping the start.
open_points.question: What happens when an unreferenced value-bytes file cannot be removed at startup?
options: Continue startup, leave the file unserved, and retry at a later start
Continue only for specified removal errors and refuse for others
open_points.default_guess: Refuse to start because the text unconditionally says these files are removed and grants non-fatal removal failure only to spool directories.

open_points.subject: A18 cleanup ordering against startup recovery
open_points.text: A18 says unreferenced value bytes are removed “On start,” while A14 rule 5 also advances recovered runs on start and that advancement can itself leave published value bytes unnamed if its store call fails.
open_points.question: Does unreferenced-value cleanup run before startup recovery, after it, or both, and therefore are orphan value bytes created by failed startup recovery removed during that same start or only a later start?
options: Clean before recovery; recovery-created orphans remain until the next start
Clean after recovery; recovery-created orphans are removed during the same start
Clean both before and after recovery
open_points.default_guess: Clean before recovery, so “the next start” means the next later startup for an orphan created during recovery.
